verdict.rationale: Apify's API v2 docs describe webhooks that configure the platform to perform an action, such as an HTTP request to another service, when a system event occurs. The docs also show webhooks triggering another Actor when a run finishes or fails. Together this covers the core of subscribing to platform events. Missing for 10: a documented catalog of subscribable event types, payload/delivery details (retries, signing), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
